title: Onboard arcturus-13b v1.0 — perf profiles, metadata, and changelog automation
author: Maya Gupta
description: Onboard `arcturus-13b` v1.0 into the model registry with full metadata, validated performance profiles for common hardware targets, and automated changelog/release-note generation. Motivation: arcturus has been stabilized in upstream training and shows competitive latency/quality tradeoffs for mid-sized production workloads. This PR covers three areas: 1) model metadata (format, tokenizer, param counts, supported precisions), 2) performance profiles (A100-80GB, A10G-40GB, T4 quantized paths) with benchmark harness outputs and recommended default serving configs, and 3) CI automation to append a standardized release note entry to the CHANGELOG when the model is tagged for release. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata JSON and README snippet - [x] Generate and include perf profiles (latency/throughput/peak-mem) - [x] Add quantization compatibility notes and recommended config - [x] Add integration test that runs small perf harness on CI (smoke) - [x] Add changelog automation job and template - [x] Update registry index and bump registry version Testing & validation: - Local perf harness runs against A100 and A10G produced results consistent with attached profiles (see commits). - Integration smoke job on CI runs with sample input (50 prompts) and verifies output shape and basic perplexity sanity checks. Rollout: The model entry is feature-flagged behind registry config `enable_experimental_models` and will be enabled for canary customers by the platform team after a small capacity soak. Related: ENG-9012 (model onboarding), PM-341 (product spec).

Sofia Ramirez: Changelog automation workflow looks fine but please restrict it to registry maintainers — otherwise we'll get noise on model drafts.
Maya Gupta: Workflow updated to only run on PR merge when label 'release-note' is present and limiting permissions to registry-team. Added README docs for maintainers.

merge_details: Merged by squash (Sofia Ramirez) on 2025-11-20. Merge commit message: 'onboard arcturus-13b v1.0: metadata + perf profiles + changelog automation'. Registry version bumped to 2025-11-12. Changelog automation appended release note to CHANGELOG.md under 'Unreleased' and created a draft release note artifact.
release_notes: - Add arcturus-13b v1.0 to model registry: metadata, README, and recommended serving configs. - Include validated performance profiles for A100-80GB, A10G-40GB, and T4 8-bit quantized path (median/p95 latency and throughput). - Add CI smoke test and changelog automation workflow to auto-populate release notes on model release.
notes_for_ops: Feature-flagged entry; platform ops should enable canary via registry config 'enable_experimental_models' for 2-4 canary customers and monitor latency and error rates for 48h. If 95th percentile latency increases by >20% vs baseline, rollback by disabling entry in registry/index.json.
